tasks.short: Arrange vessel repairs, fuel and supplies

steps.what: Inspect the actual vessel's repair need, fuel state and supply stock and capture the required items and timing
Locate the actual supplier contact and applicable vessel service details
Arrange repairs, fuel and supplies by discussing actual scope, availability and timing with the supplier
outputs: actual proposed service or supply terms

steps.what: Assemble the actual service or supply order with the captured scope, quantity, price, vessel and timing
inputs: actual proposed service or supply terms
outputs: draft vessel service or supply order

steps.what: Check every order field against actual terms and requirements and complete the exact final order
inputs: draft vessel service or supply order
actual proposed service or supply terms

steps.what: Review the completed exact order under the actual existing vessel-owner purchasing authority
outputs: approval for exact final vessel order

steps.what: Transmit the exact approved order to the selected supplier
inputs: approval for exact final vessel order

steps.what: Read the actual supplier confirmation and enter its agreed timing in the existing vessel arrangement record used for scheduling
Save the ordinary arrangement entry in the same system

tasks.design: Reuse supplier and vessel fields in {PROCUREMENT} and {OTHER}, the vessel maintenance and operating system, to assemble the actual order. Keep inspection, supplier discussion and exact field checks human, then send through {EMAIL} only after the existing purchasing authority has reviewed the final version.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same vessel, supplier and agreed scope can be copied repeatedly into an order and its dispatch.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit order fields support deterministic assembly and version-bound transmission.
tasks.still_hard: Actual repair scope, compatibility, supplier availability and vessel timing require direct checks.
tasks.human_edge: The operator knows the vessel and recognizes a proposed service that will not address its condition.

ambition.what: No autonomous purchasing or equipment release.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured service-order fields can generate an exact order and dispatch it after version-bound human purchasing approval.

assumptions: This boundary is an actual order-based arrangement under the vessel owner's existing purchasing route. s6 represents that real route only, not a newly invented supervisor approval. Confirm actual authority and substitute the actual workflow if different; the author does not approve her own paperwork.

s1 counts actual condition and stock capture; s3 captures supplier scope, price and timing. No clean new vessel feed or free quote capture is presumed. Supplier quote production is outside focal labour.

s2 removes2 of10 supplier/vessel navigation units;8 remain for actual selection and checks. s4 removes only repeated exact-field assembly, not scope judgment. Test native order functions first; existing generation and dispatch earn zero new gain.

s5 retains field correction and actual completion; upkeep includes failed assembly/dispatch repair. The exact final version exists before s6; edits to supplier, scope, quantity, price or timing void approval before s7.

s8 is the real arrangement entry used to schedule the vessel, not a new report. It follows actual confirmation. Save1 is negligible and fully retained without an author gate. Shares are unmeasured work estimates.
unknowns: Actual purchasing authority and order route
research_questions: Which copy and dispatch actions remain manual in the existing purchasing system?

already_counted.description: Actual vessel inspection/capture, supplier discussion, retained lookup, exact order checks and actual confirmation capture remain counted.
Existing vessel-owner purchasing review remains counted outside focal labour.

incremental.description: Maintain vessel/supplier order mappings and repair failed assembly or dispatch cases.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final vessel order completed in s5 and reviewed in s6; any supplier, scope, quantity, price or timing change voids approval.

tasks.short: Direct boat loading, unloading and seating

steps.what: Observe the actual boat, load, passengers, landing conditions and available crew
Read the applicable boat's loading and seating references and locate its current arrangement page
Determine the specific loading, unloading and seating directions for the actual conditions
Check immediate physical readiness and accept the exact directions under the operator's actual vessel authority
Issue the exact live loading, unloading and seating directions and watch how passengers and crew respond

tasks.design: Link the boat-specific loading and seating reference in {DOCS} to {OTHER}, the vessel's operating reference set. Keep actual observation, direction selection, immediate readiness and live directions with the operator.
tasks.previous_blocker: The relevant arrangement page can require navigation in the boat's reference set.
tasks.enabler_now: A native boat/page link removes only that retrieval component.
tasks.still_hard: Loads, passengers, landing movement and response to directions change in real time.
tasks.human_edge: The operator sees the situation and adapts commands to actual responses.

ambition.what: No automated loading or passenger commands.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: boat-specific reference links can shorten retrieval but loading and seating directions depend on live human observation.

assumptions: Boundary is the actual boat-direction episode. No trailing loading report or passenger record is invented where none is kept or read.
s1 counts actual boat, passenger and load observation. s2 counts reading the real reference and removes1 of10 navigation units;9 remain. Current native bookmarks earn zero new gain.

s3 determines the exact operative directions before s4 checks immediate readiness. a1 gates a real live operating command, not approval of authored paperwork. The operator must hold the actual vessel authority; any changed load, direction or live condition requires a new check.

No helper issues commands or delays urgent direction. Any actual formal manifest or written dispatch needs its real separate work and final-version authority. Shares are unmeasured activity estimates.
research_questions: Is reference navigation a real repeated action in this boat operation?

already_counted.description: Actual observation, reference reading, direction judgment, live readiness and human commands remain counted.

incremental.description: Check boat-reference links after arrangement revisions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact directions selected in s3 for the live conditions checked in s4; any condition or direction change voids the readiness decision.

role.altitude: Actual vessel needs, supplier negotiation and live boat directions remain human; exact order assembly and specific reference navigation can shrink.
reach: Work with the actual vessel-owner purchasing authority on exact service-order fields.
role.ambitious_version: An operator who arranges vessel needs with less repeated entry while keeping purchasing authority and live vessel directions explicit.
